players.product: quantum system contract development and manufacturing: control systems, dilution refrigerators and flexible cables (Rigetti); planned outsourced production partner for Quantinuum systems

connects_to.relationship: develops control systems, dilution refrigerators, flexible cables and other non-QPU components for Rigetti quantum computers (Collaboration Agreement, Feb 2025)

contracts.signal: Rigetti (10-K): under the February 2025 Collaboration Agreement, Quanta Computer Inc. will develop the Covered Components listed in statements of work to Rigetti's specifications and requirements - control systems, dilution refrigerators, flexible cables and select other non-QPU components for Rigetti's quantum computers; each party agreed to invest at least $250 million in quantum computing over the next five years (Quanta's investment toward personnel and capital expenditures for developing products, services and manufacturing capability in furtherance of Rigetti's roadmap).

players.product: superconducting QPUs made in its own Fab-1 (84-qubit Ankaa-3 on Amazon Braket, 36-qubit Cepheus-1-36Q chiplet system, 9-qubit Novera on-premises QPU)

quarterly_data.signal: Rigetti (10-K): revenue from U.S. government entities accounted for 48.0% of total revenue in 2025 and 54.2% in 2024; Rigetti has historically generated most of its revenue from a limited number of customers.
quarterly_data.figure: U.S. government entities 48.0% of 2025 revenue (54.2% in 2024)

quarterly_data.signal: Customer C-DAC: in January 2026 Rigetti's Indian subsidiary received an $8.4 million purchase order to deliver a 108-qubit quantum computer to C-DAC (India's Centre for Development of Advanced Computing), to be installed on-premises at C-DAC's Bengaluru center and deployed in the second half of 2026.

Rigetti (10-K): owns and operates Fab-1, a wafer fabrication facility dedicated to prototyping and producing its quantum processors; it may seek to upgrade Fab-1 and possibly invest in a new quantum chip fabrication facility.

Rigetti (10-K): in finance it is developing application expertise and collaborating with Moody's, HSBC and Standard Chartered Bank; besides Amazon Web Services and Microsoft Azure it names Strangeworks as a distribution relationship.

connects_to.relationship: Rigetti QPU access distributed through Amazon Braket

contracts.signal: Rigetti (10-K): offers its quantum computing services directly and indirectly through public cloud providers such as Amazon Braket, which integrate Rigetti's QCS into their own quantum computing platforms; Rigetti has a distribution agreement with Amazon's Braket service, and its 84-qubit Ankaa-3 quantum computer is available on Amazon Braket.

connects_to.relationship: Rigetti QPU access distributed through Azure Quantum

contracts.signal: Rigetti (10-K): Microsoft Azure Quantum integrates Rigetti's QCS into its quantum computing platform; Rigetti has a distribution agreement with Microsoft's Azure Quantum Service giving Azure customers access to its systems.
